sql:
SELECT
  str,
  interval,
  date_trunc(str, ts, 'Australia/Sydney') = date_bin(interval::interval, ts, timestamp with time zone '2001-01-01+11') AS equal
FROM (
  VALUES
  ('day', '1 d'),
  ('hour', '1 h'),
  ('minute', '1 m'),
  ('second', '1 s'),
  ('millisecond', '1 ms'),
  ('microsecond', '1 us')
) intervals (str, interval),
(VALUES (timestamptz '2020-02-29 15:44:17.71393+00')) ts (ts)
shape: SELECT str, interval, date_trunc(str, ts, 'Australia/Sydney') = date_bin(interval::interval, ts, timestamp WITH TIME ZONE '2001-01-01+11') AS equal FROM (VALUES ('day', '1 d'), ('hour', '1 h'), ('minute', '1 m'), ('second', '1 s'), ('millisecond', '1 ms'), ('microsecond', '1 us')) AS intervals(str, interval), (VALUES (timestamptz '2020-02-29 15:44:17.71393+00')) AS ts(ts);

sql:
SELECT
  interval,
  ts,
  origin,
  date_bin(interval::interval, ts, origin)
FROM (

  ('10 seconds'),
  ('100 milliseconds'),
  ('250 microseconds')
) intervals (interval),

(VALUES (timestamptz '2001-01-01')) origin (origin)
